The [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] [[Narsk Ka'hane]] had an '''auntie''' who raised him on the planet [[Verdanth]] after his parents died during the [[Republic Dark Age]]. She was a member of the Bothan emigrant community on that planet and had experienced being ruled by 27 different [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]]<ref name="Knight Errant">[[Knight Errant (novel)|''Knight Errant'']]</ref> by the year [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of [[Knight Errant (novel)|''Knight Errant'']] to [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]].</ref>
